topics.title: Artemis II crew gets top space honor
topics.summary: The Artemis II astronauts will receive the Congressional Space Medal of Honor after their lunar flyby, a rare award for a mission that carried the first non-American astronaut around the moon.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio had to host a moon-mission medal ceremony, who would make it classy, and who would accidentally turn it into a roast?

topics.title: Whales move into warmer Greenland waters
topics.summary: Scientists say retreating East Greenland sea ice has opened summer feeding areas for humpback, fin, and minke whales, while Arctic species such as narwhals may face growing pressure.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a new crowd suddenly discovered the studio's best snack spot, who would welcome them, and who would start guarding the fridge?

topics.title: DR Congo peace talks get roadmap
topics.summary: The DR Congo government and M23 rebels agreed on a roadmap for further peace talks in Switzerland, including timelines and a process for tracking ceasefire concerns.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a messy group project finally gets a roadmap, who follows it carefully, and who immediately asks for a shortcut?

topics.title: UK rail operator hit by power outage
topics.summary: CrossCountry cancelled almost all UK services after a Birmingham control-centre power cut disrupted key systems, leaving many passengers facing major Sunday travel changes.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio's whole schedule got wrecked by one power cut, who would improvise smoothly, and who would blame the coffee machine?
